encodes: A version 1 receipt carries no authorizationCommitment, so no link is attempted at all.
provenance: x402 offer-receipt extension section 5.6.4, as proposed in pull request 3827 at commit e617b3e46b8aa0782ee129fad515eb0730307e9f
a gap found while mapping our own outcomes to the six names that commit introduced: 19 October 2026, not_attempted had zero vectors in this corpus
description: A version 1 receipt predates the authorizationCommitment field entirely, so there is nothing to open and nothing to fail. This is a different fact from NOT_LINKED (a commitment that opens on no candidate) and from AMBIGUOUS (a commitment that opens on more than one): here there was never a commitment to evaluate, which the spec names not_attempted rather than folding into either failure mode.

context.note: Same real settlement transaction as opens-live.json, but the receipt payload is the version 1 shape, which has no authorizationCommitment field to evaluate.

expected.note: Deliberately carries no `valid`. The candidate set could not be obtained, so this says nothing about the receipt. Writing valid:false here would blame an honest seller for a failed chain read. This is the third-outcome gap discussed in x402#3396.
